annotations.title: Edit a Google Business Profile Post

description: Edit a Post already live on the brand’s Google Business Profile listing, in place, instead of deleting and re-posting it: its text (summary), its button (actionType + link), an EVENT or OFFER’s title and dates, an OFFER’s coupon, redeem link or terms, or its photo (imageUrl). Only the fields you pass change. The edit is PUBLIC and immediate, so show the user the new wording and get their go-ahead first. A Post’s type cannot change (that is a new Post) and Google takes no video. The reply is built from the Post Google returns, and names any field Google did not keep. Pass the full post name from list_google_business_posts. Needs Google Business Profile connected.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

imageUrl.description: a Hermoso render image URL (or an upload_file url) to replace the photo

link.description: the URL the button opens; not for CALL, and ignored on an OFFER

postId.description: the full post name from list_google_business_posts (accounts/…/locations/…/localPosts/…)

redeemOnlineUrl.description: OFFER only: the link Google uses on an offer

name: update_google_business_post
